data.why: The repo ships its own synthetic-data generators (tests/make_test_data.py, tests/make_analysis_data.py) that build a biologically-realistic Aperio-style H&E whole-slide image plus a matched GeoJSON cell layer, QuPath-style measurement TSV and ROI GeoJSON, registered to the same coordinates; these are generated into app/sample_data during install (not copied from prep/data) and served directly by `wissi-viz serve`, which auto-pairs the slide with same-stem annotation/table files.

goals: Open a whole-slide H&E image and navigate/zoom across it smoothly
Load an existing cell/object layer (QuPath-style measurements) onto the slide and inspect per-cell measurements
Annotate new cells or regions with SAM 2.1 (click/box) or drawing tools and assign a class
Find all objects similar to a few picked examples across the whole slide
Run spatial statistics (density/hotspots, nearest-neighbour, Ripley's K/L, neighbourhood enrichment) on the detected cells and inspect the resulting table, overlay and chart
Measure region-level composition (counts, share, cells per mm^2) inside a tumour ROI versus its invasive margin

review.summary: The tree captures this tool's core loop of viewing, inspecting detected cells, building regions and running spatial statistics, and most cited screens show exactly what the nodes claim. It needs fixes before filing: the example-marking phase stops before its find step, the stated tumour-vs-margin comparison is missing and is stood in for by a circular composition on Tumor-made regions, and the sync and Fit claims overstate what the screens show.
